provenance: Frame data transcribed from game/data/combat/frames.json (RI-CMB02 §A/§B, S22-rebased). Geometry from game/data/combat/hitgeometry.json (RI-CMB04 §B). Neither is re-derived here; this file selects the POSE and the WEAPON for the class and nothing else.

weapon.attack_rating_provenance: PROVISIONAL, constructed. RI-CMB02 defines motion values but no attack rating; AR is owned by RI-WPN01/RI-WPN02 (wave-1 piece W1-10). The straight sword's 118 is pinned to the RI-CMB07 exemplar's canonical R1 HIT (dmg 118 at motion value 1.00), which is not frame data and therefore survives the S22 invalidation. The other six are scaled from it and must be re-derived by W1-10.

two_handed._note: RI-CMB02 §C prices two-handing and RI-WPN06 §B forbids it being only a price: "TDV == 0 for any weapon -- HARD FAIL. The 2h clips are the 1h clips." So the two-handed rows select a DIFFERENT POSE ARCHETYPE (chop_overhead here: the head is driven straight down instead of swept horizontally), a different amplitude and a different root displacement, on top of §C's x1.15 stamina / x1.15 motion value / x1.30 poise damage and its unchanged (x1.00) frame counts. W1-09's class spine has two slots (light, heavy), so this build can diverge two of the twelve slots RI-WPN06 §B measures TDV over; the other ten are RI-WPN01 slots owned by wave-1 piece W1-10 and this file does not pretend to them.
